ns2:section.sectionText: Note: Students must register for the lecture and one lab. Broadcast majors will register for sections AB1 or AB2 and News-Editorial majors will register for sections AB3 or AB4. Non-Journalism majors that have been accepted into the PR Certificate program should visit https://illinois.edu/fb/sec/1773821 to indicate their interest in this and other required PR Cert. courses. Space is limited and seats will be granted on a first come/first served basis only. Students who have completed JOUR 400 should not register for JOUR 210. While the number is different, the course content is the same. Registering for the new course would be seen as duplicate credit. Duplicate credit does not count toward graduation and students registering for the duplicate course will be asked to drop.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Agr & Environmental Cmc & Educ or Journalism or News-Editorial or Broadcast Journalism or Agricultural Communications major(s).
